S1.description: Structured data reasoning: reasoning over flight durations, product specifications across multiple records

S2.description: Tool calling precision: incorrect item IDs, wrong payment method routing, wrong tool parameters leading to DB mismatches

S3.description: Multi-step completion: failing to complete all required actions across multiple orders/reservations, or losing track mid-conversation

S4.description: Precondition verification: failing to check cancellation eligibility, basic economy restrictions, origin/destination change prohibition, insurance coverage requirements

S5.description: Numerical reasoning: incorrect payment splits, wrong certificate/gift card math, wrong compensation amounts

S6.description: Record discovery: failing to find correct reservations, wrong order IDs, inability to locate user accounts, missing relevant records

S7.description: Information communication: DB succeeded but failed to communicate required details (refund amounts, item specifications, tracking numbers)

S8.description: Conditional/state reasoning: wrong order state transitions, failure to adapt when initial action changes order status, misreading conditional task instructions

S9.description: Language fluency: no clear evidence of failures attributable to language generation quality

S10.description: Response latency: not measurable from conversation logs

S11.description: Tone/empathy: failing to hold policy under social pressure, or failing to explain difficult news empathetically

S12.description: Hallucination of tools: attempting invalid tool call sequences (remove item without replacement, exchange non-pending orders), or accepting user claims not in system data

S13.description: Format compliance: no clear evidence of format-specific failures

S14.description: Context window management: getting stuck in repetitive loops, failing to recognize conversation completion, losing track of task state over long conversations

S15.description: Multilingual handling: French-language request may have affected policy comprehension

S16.description: Proactive upselling: no evidence of failures in this dimension
